info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Channel Specific Advanced Voice Services Managements-spec
info.description: The Channel-Specific Advanced Voice Services Management API allows businesses to access and manage advanced voice services tailored for specific channels. This functionality provides users with the ability to list and scrutinize various voice service configurations and their effectiveness across different communication channels. Typical consumers of this API include product managers, system integrators, and application developers looking to optimize voice service delivery. By leveraging this API, businesses can enhance user experience and operational efficiency in their voice-based communication strategies.

get.summary: Retrieve advanced voice services for a specific channel.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to access detailed information about advanced voice services available for a specified channel. It provides insights into the features, configurations, and operational status of the voice services.
